usage: state-manage.py clean-temp [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--node NODE]
                                  [--yes] [--force]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT  Project root (default: current directory)
  --node NODE        Only this node id (prefix is enough)
  --yes              Actually delete; without it, only list
  --force            Also clear a node a cycle is holding right now (its
                     session is gone and the claim was never released)
